business_problem: The centre needed to modernize environmental monitoring with AI so staff, decision makers and the public could retrieve monitoring knowledge, run quality-control workflows and analyze environmental quality faster.
solution_summary: China National Environmental Monitoring Centre built an industry large-model development and application platform on Baidu AI Cloud's Qianfan ModelBuilder and AppBuilder. The platform is designed to cover the full monitoring data lifecycle: it supports data governance, sector knowledge-base construction, algorithm-tool development and agent building instead of limiting AI to one narrow assistant. Within that shared environment, the centre began creating assistants for ecological-quality situation analysis, environmental-quality monitoring operations and technical-knowledge Q&A. That means the same Qianfan-based foundation can serve different audiences: government decision makers needing fast access to quality data, monitoring staff who need workflow control and key-information pushes during operations, and domain practitioners who need technically accurate answers pulled from sector knowledge. Architecturally, the centre is using Baidu's large-model tooling as a domain platform rather than a single application, aiming to turn environmental data into a smarter governance and service asset across the organization.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Supports development and tuning of environmental-monitoring large-model applications.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Packages monitoring assistants and agent workflows for operational use.

solution_components.name: Environmental Monitoring Industry LLM Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the shared development and application environment for sector-specific AI capabilities.

solution_components.name: Monitoring Knowledge Base
solution_components.role: Stores and organizes environmental-monitoring domain knowledge for Q&A and assistants.

data_flow: Monitoring data, sector documents and governance rules are organized into knowledge bases and agent tools on the Qianfan platform, then surfaced through assistants for quality analysis, operations control and technical Q&A.
business_outcome: The centre created a reusable environmental-monitoring AI platform that improves data access, workflow control and technical knowledge retrieval across multiple monitoring scenarios.
